newsitem.title: UK: Emery appoints two to Euro automotive team.
newsitem.headline: Emery appoints two to Euro automotive team.

text.p: Emery Worldwide announced Friday two new appointments to its European automotive team.
Phil Walker and Mark Silver are taking on the new posts of Global Account Manager, Automotive for UK, Ireland and Scaninavia and Operations Manager Automotive - Europe, respectively.

Emery vice president for Europe, Middle East and Africa Peter Quantrill said the new appointments will boost Emery's focused operational and sales plan to further increase its multi-national business in the growing automotive industry.
Emery is the Redwood City, Ca.-based subsidiary of Consolidated Freightways Inc. of Palo Alto, Calif. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
